title: 'Get your bearings' (and variants like 'get your bearings from the parapet/head-frame/parade') is a numbered menu action that costs a turn exactly like combat or dialogue, but reads just like the free 'look' meta-command described in the rules — there's no visual cue distinguishing a costed in-fiction 'look-alike' from the genuinely free look/status commands.
